Source_review_dependencies: Distinct reviewer must read this small Source, complete literal case array and scope. No Source call during review. Point implementation Source/review is a different author/lane.
expected_values: No stored truth sets, counts, satisfiability labels or forced-bit answer tables. Future callable generically enumerates every bit assignment, evaluates each clause directly, derives satisfying sets/semantic forced bits, and separately computes unit closure from declarations.
future_ownership: ROOT authors actual paired caller/data intake/source guard/deadline/resource scope after independent review; no owned worker/plan/cold fit is supplied. Do not import the point implementation into this oracle or treat this oracle as its candidate-pruning procedure.
intake: Strict integer variable/bit/sign fields reject booleans; distinct indices per clause and prefix. Empty clause and no-clause CNF both supported. Duplicate clause occurrences retained. Whole case inventory required.
internal_helpers: require/bit/declaration/clause_true/unit_closure are internal; only validated whole public intake supplies evaluation authority.
result_scope: Exact finite Boolean truth-table/conditional-unit metadata only. Parent point implementation must compare full projected solution set and whole state; its own scheduler/incidence/rollback and guard-placement qualification remain separate.
